postconditions.expression: not any(grid[i][j] == grid[i+1][j] or grid[i][j] == grid[i][j+1] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: Bob wins if there is no conflict in the grid after n^2 turns.

invariants.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == n for row in grid)
invariants.description: The grid is always n x n.

invariants.expression: not any(grid[i][j] == grid[i+1][j] or grid[i][j] == grid[i][j+1] for i in range(n-1) for j in range(n-1))
invariants.description: There is no conflict in the grid at the start of each turn.
